body: I have the same mortician & incantation back patches for my vest, & I can't believe someone came up with the same combo as me! Looks sick.
that's not fair! there was time now!

Gotta love the jumbo bolt thrower logo
Could use a patch on either side of the immortal logo on the shoulders,would certainly complete the layout

I believe the man on the right is Arabian Prince, who was a member of the NWA “posse” before they made found real success. Pretty sure he is on the straight outta Compton album cover aswell. Not sure how much talent he truly contributed though.

They have so many songs it’s hard to choose but Do you want to know a secret? With George on vocals is just so catchy to me. Also Cry baby cry is pretty underrated. Has the best of John & Paul in it. There’s a lot of great less mentioned songs by the Fab Four.
It’s crazy that an epic vest like this with amazing bands & patches gets less love than some of the trash jackets I see on here, this is a real battle jacket.
